_readme: Pre-written announcements for /announce template:<name>. The text opens in a form so you can edit it before posting. Placeholders: {legion} {ea} {ea_relative} {launch} {launch_relative} {registration} {announcements} {faction} {roles} {guides} {events}. "joinButton": true attaches the one-click Join button and live roster to the post.

recruitment.title: ⚜️ AION2 is coming. {legion} is assembling. Are you in?
recruitment.body:
The wings are back. 🪽

⏳ **Early Access:** {ea} · opens **{ea_relative}**
🚀 **Global launch:** {launch} · **{launch_relative}**
(times shown in *your* local time, and the countdown updates live)

{legion} is building its AION2 legion **right now**, so on day one we log in as a squad, not as strangers.

🛡️ **Faction: {faction}.** Light side, white wings, best-looking capital. Roll Elyos or you won't find us.
🌍 **Server:** revealed on launch day the moment NC opens the list. Keep an eye on {announcements}.

**Joining takes one click.** Smash **Join {legion}** below and your name goes on the roster for everyone to see. No forms, no interviews, no waiting.

Then, while you wait for the servers:
🎯 Pick your class in {roles}
📖 Read **Kanon's AION 2 Bible** in {guides} (yes, the whole thing)

All 8 classes wanted. Tanks, healers, glass cannons, and that one friend who only plays Chanter.

See you in Atreia. ⚜️

early-access.title: ⏳ AION2 Early Access: {ea_relative}
early-access.body:
Early Access (Founder's Pack) opens **{ea}**.
Global free-to-play launch: **{launch}**.

**Before you log in**
• Finish the download early. Don't wait for server-open.
• Read **Kanon's AION 2 Bible** in {guides}.
• Lock in your class and set your role in {roles}.
• Not in the legion yet? Hit **Join** on the recruitment post in {announcements} **today**.

The legion meet-up time will be posted in {events} once NC confirms server-open time.
